headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 12, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.63% compared to SPY's 14.06%. This 12.56% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 48.54%, contributing significantly to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still shows a positive return of 18.52%, highlighting the relative strength of the portfolio set. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
